title: A finite Smith–Toda complex V(4) at the prime 1009
summary: We construct a Smith–Toda complex $`V(4)`$ at the prime 1009. It is an ordinary finite 1009-local spectrum whose Brown–Peterson homology is $`BP_*/(1009,v_1,v_2,v_3,v_4)`$, with its canonical comodule structure and generator in degree zero.
family_title: Finite Smith–Toda complexes at every height

review.reason: Constructs a finite Smith–Toda complex V(4) at the prime 1009.

discussion.title: The Smith-Toda complex V(4) exists for p >= 11
discussion.author: Vigleik Angeltveit
discussion.text: We show that the Smith-Toda complex V(4) exists for all primes p >= 11. This improves on the recently announced result by OpenAI that V(4) exists at the prime 1009.
